description: Pipeline Monitor (PM, 简称 PM) is the local pipeline-watching GUI for the Yifu pipeline: a FastAPI app (default http://127.0.0.1:8766) over a file-backed serial job queue under YIFU_ANALYSIS_ROOT/_active. Agents enqueue or attach runs here; operators watch progress, ETA and logs in the browser.

rules: Whole-brain production runs must avoid TIFF intermediates: stream Imaris .ims directly with pipeline_modules.preprocessing.ims_to_zarr and pre-create the inputs main.py skips on (ch<signal>.zarr, ch<reg>_downsample/volume.nii.gz, sample_dir/original_shape.json). See pipeline_modules/preprocessing/capability_manifest.json.

Preprocessing/enhancement is OFF by default in production configs (every preprocessing.*.apply=false) so segmentation thresholds operate on raw stored intensities and stay comparable across samples and batches.

Custom multi-step flows that main.py cannot express (e.g. ims->zarr->segmentation->masked ims) are launched as driver scripts and attached to PM via ActiveStore.attach_external, never by hand-editing queue files.
One job runs at a time. To wait for the current run, poll ActiveStore.has_running() or GET /api/jobs; never launch heavy pipelines outside PM while a job is running.

entrypoints.description: Validate a sample directory under the analysis root (S:\Arivis_Analysis) and append a kind=main job to the PM queue. config.json must exist in the sample dir (or pass config_path). The runner picks it up automatically: the GUI polls GET /api/jobs -> runner.maybe_start(), so a queued job starts as soon as nothing else is running and the browser/UI is open (or immediately after a POST /api/jobs).

sample_dir.description: Must be a subdirectory of the analysis root, not the _active/jobs|runs bookkeeping folders

entrypoints.description: Track an already-running custom driver as a PM job. Call this at driver start (see _run_YF2025063002_vessel.py for the reference implementation). PM derives status from the status file's FIRST line: RUNNING ... / ALL DONE / FAILED ... / CANCELLED, with 'Step <n>' parsed for the step display; write the ISO start time on line 2. Re-running attach_external on the same sample_dir updates the existing record instead of duplicating it.

pid.description: Driver process id; PM marks the job failed if the pid dies while the status line still says RUNNING

log_path.description: Driver log file shown in the PM log view

status_path.description: Two-line status file: first line = <STATE> [Step n: description], second line = started_at ISO

job.description: Synced external job record visible in PM

entrypoints.description: List PM jobs with live progress, ETA (from historical step timings) and SampleLayout result listing. REST equivalent: GET http://127.0.0.1:8766/api/jobs (this call also triggers runner.maybe_start(), i.e. opening the PM page starts the next queued job).
True while any job (main or external) is running. Poll this every ~60 s before launching new work; a running EXTERNAL job blocks the serial runner exactly like a main job.

Start Pipeline Monitor (PM). REST API: GET /api/meta, GET /api/jobs (auto-starts queued), POST /api/jobs {sample_dir, config_path}, DELETE /api/jobs/{id}, POST /api/queue/start, POST /api/queue/cancel, POST /api/jobs/{id}/cancel, GET /api/jobs/{id}/log?tail=N.

queue_semantics.storage: YIFU_ANALYSIS_ROOT/_active: queue.json (ordered ids), jobs/*.json (records), runs/<job_id>/ (progress.json + stdout log)
queue_semantics.serial: One running job at a time across kinds; next_queued() is only started when nothing is running
queue_semantics.external_block: Jobs with kind=external are never started by the runner itself; they only occupy the running slot while their pid is alive

reference_drivers: _run_YF2025063002_vessel.py (ims -> zarr -> 25um registration nii -> main.py threshold + hemisphere -> L/R stats)
